messages:
elaine: Quick sync — Nimbus HW + Atlas SI are ready to sign but want a private offer template. Need final on commit tiers, HW credit kicker, renewal discount and launch announcement timing. TL;DR: they want 3yr commit with front-loaded usage credits and an SI co-sell incentive. Can we converge today? :raised_hands:

matt_s: +1. Sales wants clearer SKU mapping so partners can quote. Our suggestion: commit buckets at $200k, $750k, $2.5M ARR-equivalent with progressive discounts 10/18/25% off list T&M for hosted inference. Also include hardware kicker as 10% of committed value in deployment credits usable for Dedicated capacity.

sophia_p: That's fine. One ask: make the credits time-boxed to year 1-2 only to avoid long tail liabilities. Also propose renewal accelerator: additional 5% off for renewals signed within 90 days before expiry.

jordan_f: Finance flags — don't promise HW credits >15% total or it blows margin. Suggest cap credits at $150k per customer and tie to verified usage telemetry. Also need to amortize commit revenue for ASC606.

anita_legal: We'll need the private offer wording for credit redemption and transfer restrictions. Also ensure SI incentive is a referral credit, not a rebate (to avoid reseller complications). I'll draft clauses.

devon_se: From SI POV: Atlas needs milestone-based tranches so their SIs can get paid. Recommend 3 milestone payouts (kickoff, first production, successful training batch) tied to usage signals. Also they want co-marketing funds — can we carve out a 2% MDF from commit?

matt_s: MDF ok but needs approval. Can we do 2% MDF + 5% SI referral out of our discount pool at the mid-tier? That keeps top-level discount intact.

elaine: Proposal to finalize: Private offer template with 3 commit tiers (200k/750k/2.5M), HW deployment credits = min(10% commit, $150k cap), MDF 2% optional, SI referral up to 5% (deducted from discount pool), renewal accelerator +5% for early renew. Announcement: joint blog + marketplace private offer page + joint webinar 4 weeks after signing. Any objections?

sophia_p: No objections. Request: create SKU mapping snippet for listing. Will need to run UI card by marketing.

matt_s: I'll prep SKUs. Quick sketch:
```
SKU: REDW-PRIV-200K
Commit: $200000
Discount: 10%
HW_credit: min(10%,150000)
MDF: 2%
SI_referral: up to 5%
```

jordan_f: FYI — add billing rule: monthly reconciliation and true-up at year end. Also require telemetry tag to apply credits.

anita_legal: I'll post draft private offer T&C in the thread in 1 hour.

marketplace-bot: Created draft private offer record #PO-4721 and set review owner to @elaine.

elaine: Great. I'll consolidate and send to Nimbus/Atlas legal. If no major blockers, we'll lock this by EOD and queue announcement for Apr 18. :rocket:
